email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Utilities Engineer, Civil Infrastructure advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Part of that work was lodging Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designing around existing services and site constraints. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, carrying out inspections and coordinating with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert mentions reviewing BYDA information and civil designs for utility conflicts, which builds on the service checks I did in my course. I have not worked as a utilities engineer yet, so I would start at entry level, and I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short call about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application: Utilities Engineer, Civil Infrastructure
paragraphs: I saw your advert on SEEK for a Utilities Engineer to support the identification, investigation and coordination of utilities affected by major civil works, and I would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries, followed its procedures and designed around existing services and site constraints. My coursework also covered risk registers, cost estimates and bills of quantities. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against the work, carried out inspections and quality checks, kept site reports and material records, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, licence and transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not worked as a utilities engineer, and my software experience is from study rather than commercial work, so I would start at entry level. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about how I could support your utilities team.
